"""Audit reproduction only: a passing check confirms the observed availability gap."""
import json,sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path.cwd()/'tests/integration'))
from test_platform_institutional import runtime,ORIGIN,run
from lw_care_api.platform import db
from sqlalchemy import select,func

def test_rotating_identity_gets_fresh_budget_from_same_local_client(runtime):
 app,client,_=runtime
 def attempt(email):
  return client.post('/v1/auth/login',headers={'Origin':ORIGIN},json={'email':email,'password':'Wrong-synthetic-password-only','otp':'123456'}).status_code
 fixed=[attempt('audit-first@test.invalid') for _ in range(9)]
 rotated=[attempt('audit-second@test.invalid'),attempt('audit-third@test.invalid')]
 assert fixed==[401]*8+[429]
 assert rotated==[401,401]
 async def counts():
  async with app.state.database.transaction() as s:
   return {'rate_limit_rows':await s.scalar(select(func.count()).select_from(db.rate_limits)),'accounts':await s.scalar(select(func.count()).select_from(db.accounts))}
 observed=run(counts());assert observed=={'rate_limit_rows':3,'accounts':0}
 result={'reproduction':'CONFIRMED_APPLICATION_BUDGET_IS_IDENTITY_ONLY','same_local_client':True,'fixed_identity_http':fixed,'rotated_identity_http':rotated,**observed,'production_requests':0,'provider_edge_controls_tested':False,'authentication_bypassed':False,'passing_test_means_gap_observed_not_mitigated':True}
 (Path.cwd()/'.toolchain/redteam-auth-budget.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')

findings.finding: Rotating login identities obtain independent application budgets
findings.observed_evidence: Eight attempts to one unknown email returned 401; ninth 429. Two other emails from the same local client each returned 401 and created two more persistent limiter rows. No authentication bypass or production load test.
findings.risk: Account-only throttling does not bound total password-verification cost or limiter-key growth across changing identities. Edge protection was not verified.
findings.next_action: Implement trusted-client and aggregate admission limits, bounded TTL/key growth and explicit saturation behavior; preserve per-account limits/MFA and reject spoofed proxy identity. Qualify within existing stack.
findings.exit_evidence: Changing identities and concurrent bursts are bounded without account enumeration or MFA weakening; trusted proxy behavior, state growth and contention measured.

findings.finding: No actual Director operating loop or independent roster
findings.observed_evidence: One account; two grants belong to that one account. Zero facilities, criteria, applications, reporting definitions/obligations/returns/snapshots, activation packages, site packages and clinical coverage.
findings.next_action: Obtain actual nominations/deputies, approved facility and criteria, forms/calendar/disclosure, scoped authority and funded support. No synthetic operating records.
findings.required_owner_roles_not_appointments: Directorate and actual accountable institutional owners
findings.exit_evidence: Attributable real decisions plus witnessed complete Director loop and accepted intervention/outcome.

findings.observed_evidence: All 200 requirements and 111 formal cases remain NOT_RUN; automated engineering checks have different populations and purposes.
findings.risk: A green build or a route count cannot establish clinical, privacy, finance or institutional acceptance.
findings.next_action: Execute applicable scope-mapped formal cases with actual independent roles; retain failed/blocked cases and attributable acceptance decisions.
findings.exit_evidence: Requirement-to-case-to-result-to-decision traceability with remaining scope explicit.

findings.observed_evidence: No production scanner-host environment entry. Mandatory scan/private-storage capability is fail closed. Environment presence itself would still not qualify an engine.
findings.risk: Required file evidence cannot be waived to make affiliation or care appear usable. A configured R2 bucket is not a scanner.
findings.next_action: Keep file-dependent operation excluded until actual clean/malicious/timeout/private-access/lineage qualification is achievable within authorised stack.
findings.required_owner_roles_not_appointments: Platform/security and actual evidence service owners
findings.exit_evidence: Real scanner negative/timeout/private-access tests and retained lineage, or explicit continuing exclusion from affected operating scope.

findings.finding: Recovery rehearsal is not an assured backup and resumption service
findings.observed_evidence: Retained schema-9 nonempty Neon/R2 and newer-data-preservation proof; 22 assurance records observed. No adopted cadence, independent copy/key custody, RPO/RTO or staffed resumption evidenced.
findings.risk: Manual business-empty production rehearsal cannot establish representative clinical recovery or supported service resumption.
findings.next_action: Establish monitored cadence and independent custody; qualify representative restoration, reconciliation and staffed resumption against owner-adopted RPO/RTO.
findings.exit_evidence: Missed-backup detection, independent copy/key restoration, preserved newer events and witnessed accepted service resumption.

findings.finding: Daily jobs do not provide timely staffed escalation
findings.observed_evidence: Packaged cron is 0 0 * * *; zero clinical coverage rows observed. Worker CLI existence is not a running staffed service. No jobs dispatch was invoked by this audit.
findings.risk: Critical-result and urgent-request response times are unqualified.
findings.next_action: Define achievable actual primary/fallback coverage and escalation commitments; prove acknowledgement and continuity without adding deferred hosts.
findings.required_owner_roles_not_appointments: Actual clinical/service owners and platform operations
findings.exit_evidence: Supported timing and human response/fallback demonstrated with retained ownership through outage and handover.

findings.finding: Bounded extensions do not establish canonical parity
findings.observed_evidence: 51 forms/355 fields: 21 partial proofs, 298 explicit gaps, 36 candidates. All 75 screens open; 2 partial/28 open state families; 82 interfaces unqualified.
findings.risk: Screening, accepted teams, corrective plans/capture and source links are delivered, while wider Director forms, state semantics and leadership defaults remain partial.
findings.next_action: Reconcile specific notice/service/appeal/expiry and broader Director-first field/permission/missingness/persistence contracts against existing code.
findings.required_owner_roles_not_appointments: Domain engineering, analyst, QA and actual policy owners
findings.exit_evidence: Bounded explicit extension decisions and negative state/permission/version/replay tests; no blanket parity claim.

findings.finding: Full WAN-offline clinical operation is undelivered
findings.observed_evidence: PWA service worker provides public connection guidance and caches no charts/drafts. Full local API/DB/files/auth/department/jobs and semantic reconnect are not delivered; extra/local hosting remains deferred.
findings.risk: Full product readiness cannot be claimed while offline care is core and the needed runtime/hosting qualification is deferred.
findings.next_action: Retain offline as an explicit full-readiness blocker; obtain an actual scope/hosting decision before any future local deployment. Do not silently replace it with a PWA.

findings.finding: Referral closure lacks a separate receiving-outcome contract
findings.observed_evidence: Referral actions are REQUEST/RECORD_ACCEPTANCE/TRANSFER/CLOSE/CANCEL. CLOSE accepts TRANSFERRED without its own receiving-outcome evidence; originating clinician remains the actor.
findings.risk: Transfer records cannot prove receiving receipt or clinical outcome; decline/unreachable paths remain incomplete.
findings.next_action: Implement complete receiving/decline/unreachable/outcome responsibility and patient-visible continuity with actual counterpart governance.
findings.required_owner_roles_not_appointments: Clinical/network engineering and actual referring/receiving owners
findings.exit_evidence: Wrong receiver, unreachable, decline, missing receipt/outcome and pending responsibility transitions qualified.

findings.finding: Cash ledger does not complete care finance and sponsorship
findings.observed_evidence: Cash billing and balanced ledger are delivered; payer splits/claims/remittance/electronic settlement/controlled refunds and contracted sponsorship entitlement/reservation/reconciliation remain incomplete.
findings.risk: A balanced cash ledger is not full financial service or sponsor accounting acceptance.
findings.next_action: Complete core finance/sponsorship under actual contracts and independent financial authority; keep optional ERP separate.
findings.required_owner_roles_not_appointments: Finance engineering and actual financial/programme owners
findings.exit_evidence: Concurrent entitlement/settlement/refund/reversal and reconciliation cases with accepted records and controls.

findings.observed_evidence: MFA, current grants, no-store, protected histories, independent review and encrypted records have engineering evidence; this audit is not external independent penetration testing or privacy/clinical certification.
findings.risk: No broad assurance follows from selected guard tests. Key rotation/custody, rights/retention/exit, tenant boundaries and incident operation require review.
findings.next_action: Conduct authorised independent security/privacy and dependency review with current scope; qualify abuse resistance, keys/rights/retention/custody and incident operation.
findings.required_owner_roles_not_appointments: Independent security/privacy assessors and actual custodians
findings.exit_evidence: Traceable threat/access/dependency/privacy findings closed or explicitly accepted by actual owners; key/rights drills witnessed.

findings.observed_evidence: Prior actual Vercel/Neon 5000-record/20000-event bounds and explicit overflow refusal exist. Other simultaneous facility had no source load; no representative sustained maximum-volume correction/contention/provider telemetry/adopted targets.
findings.risk: Global low-volume governance locks and per-request reconciliation can contend. Current local pooled Neon success does not qualify Vercel production capacity.
findings.next_action: Measure bounded representative simultaneous facilities, sustained correction/replay/contention and provider cold/warm/memory/duration against actual adopted targets.
findings.required_owner_roles_not_appointments: Performance/platform/data engineering and actual service owners
findings.exit_evidence: Complete-accounting bound/overflow behavior plus reproducible sustained provider measurements and adopted targets.

findings.finding: Sandbox, supply-chain review and paired rollback remain open
findings.observed_evidence: Exact-CI/same-build/source/expected-parent promotion and probe revocation exist. Qualifiers share existing provider stack/DB connectivity; full service sandbox, dependency/licence review and newer-data-preserving paired rollback remain unqualified.
findings.risk: Six PG-only cases are skipped in SQLite CI. Latest release proves two selected Neon scenarios, not a full fresh rerun of all PG races. Expected-parent checks are not provider-side atomic CAS.
findings.next_action: Qualify least-privilege disposable proof isolation, repeatable PG release gates, complete dependency/licence/legacy surface disposition and schema-9-compatible rollback with concurrent newer data.
findings.required_owner_roles_not_appointments: Release/security/platform engineering and actual release/custody owners
findings.exit_evidence: Safe failure/cleanup receipts, verified code/schema pair, preserved newer events and accepted service resumption; no old DB restore.

findings.finding: AI readiness and interface placeholders are not adopted services
findings.observed_evidence: Free OpenRouter probe sends fixed public readiness text; no governed assistant is established. Selected-facility equipment/exchange/migration counterparts remain unqualified.
findings.risk: Provider connectivity is not governed tools/memory/data routing, useful clinical assistance or LIS/PACS/settlement operation.
findings.next_action: Keep AI bounded to existing controls until approved use cases and injection/AI-off evaluations; select/approve facilities before real counterpart interface work.
findings.exit_evidence: Approved bounded AI safety and actual identity/version/quarantine/reconciliation/migration rollback evidence.

findings.observed_evidence: Fresh 12-page/source checks and retained client/PWA tests passed. They do not exercise actual operators, keyboard/screen-reader/device behavior or interrupted submissions under representative networks.
findings.risk: A page returning 200 does not establish usability, safe subject switching or a workable clinical workflow.
findings.next_action: Execute actual manual role/device/accessibility/low-bandwidth UAT with denial, conflict, subject switch and interrupted action evidence. No Playwright installation.
findings.exit_evidence: Witnessed workflows with defects corrected, failed cases retained and actual operating acceptance.

limits: Selected source and engineering review; not external independent penetration test or every-clause certification
No authenticated production business flow, notification/jobs dispatch, backup, private record read or decrypted provider environment
No live abuse/load test, new Neon qualification, device/manual UAT or new dependency/licence vulnerability certification
Provider edge abuse protection not tested; observed rate-budget gap does not demonstrate production outage or authentication bypass
Retained capacity/recovery/Neon evidence is historical execution, not fresh audit execution
